Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive:

- Finlytics is focused on batching large-scale transactional data for real-time insights; main constraints are SSO + data residency and procurement timelines.
- You asked for an architecture-level demo (SSO, data flow, tenant isolation) and a brief ops walkthrough for peak throughput.

Proposed 45–60m demo windows (Pacific):
1) Tue Oct 5 — 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Wed Oct 6 — 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Thu Oct 7 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you pick one (or suggest a preferred alternative)? If good, well invite our platform/security and send a short Mutual Action Plan + evidence pack ahead of time.

Looping Sean (CS) to help capture success criteria and Soojin (sec/infra) to make sure we bring the right runbook/docs.

Initial evidence Ill prepare: SOC2 highlights, data flow sketch, and a procurement checklist. If procurement wants a specific template, please send it and well slot it into the MAP.

Attachments: SOC2-highlights.pdf (summary), MUTUAL-ACTION-PLAN.xlsx (blank MAP).

Thanks — Mina
